note: Literature establishes that classic/severe CdLS with structural limb reduction defects is characteristic of NIPBL variants, whereas BRD4 variants present with a milder or atypical CdLS phenotype lacking severe limb reduction defects.

evidence.text: Typical upper limb reduction defects do not present in the classic severe manner in BRD4 patients, who exhibit a milder CdLS-like phenotype.
